csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) intends to select a Construction Manager (CM) / Owner s Agent to provide services supporting ODNR s multi-year Capital Improvement Program. Owner Agent Services will support the Division of Engineering (DOE) in activities including assessments, master planning, strategic planning, design, bidding/procurement, construction administration, and project close-out for construction projects across multiple ODNR divisions, including Parks & Watercraft, Wildlife, Natural Areas & Preserves, and Forestry.

relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a construction management / owner's agent procurement, not a focused structural design commission.

- The notice includes substantial planning and PM-related services, which are generally low priority for sbp.
- No specific complex bridge, roof, stadium, or special lightweight structure is identified.
